title: UTG+1 to HJ facing an early raise
keyIdea: An early raise means a strong range, and players behind you can still squeeze. Play tight: 3-bet premiums, call with hands that don't get dominated.

notes.AQo: Looks pretty, but vs an early raise it's often dominated by AK, and you still have players behind.
notes.KJo: Dominated by AK, AJ, KQ in an early range. Fold.
